prompt: I want to forecast the sp500, show me how to do it in an interactive dashboard in html. Do not stop until you have a working and validated dashboard.

harness.name: Codex CLI
harness.command: codex --search exec --json --ignore-user-config --skip-git-repo-check --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox --model gpt-5.6-luna -c model_reasoning_effort=xhigh -C /tmp/benchmark-real-ai-gpt-5.6-luna-xhigh-X6yH7U -o /tmp/benchmark-real-ai-gpt-5.6-luna-xhigh-X6yH7U/final-response.md 'I want to forecast the sp500, show me how to do it in an interactive dashboard in html. Do not stop until you have a working and validated dashboard.'

dataSource.notes: The benchmark fetched FRED's SP500 daily close series with curl, reduced it to 121 monthly observations, and embedded the resulting snapshot through 2026-08-11 with a latest close of 7728.20. The HTML retains an optional live FRED refresh path; browser validation observed the disclosed fallback to the embedded snapshot when the live pull was unavailable.

commands.name: fresh-workspace
commands.result: The workspace was outside the repository and contained only benchmark evidence files before the dashboard was created.

commands.name: fred-search-and-fetch
commands.result: FRED returned the SP500 CSV; the final embedded data ends at 2026-08-11 with 7728.20.

commands.name: javascript-syntax
commands.command: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const h=fs.readFileSync("sp500-forecast-dashboard.html","utf8"); const js=h.match(/<script>([\s\S]*)<\/script>/)[1]; new Function(js); console.log("JS syntax OK"); console.log("HTML bytes", h.length);'
commands.result: JS syntax OK; the generated HTML was 41371 bytes on disk.

commands.name: headless-chrome-render
commands.result: Chrome rendered the dashboard and wrote a 233094-byte 1440 x 1200 screenshot.

commands.name: http-dom-initial
commands.result: Initial spot 7,728.2, 4 scenario rows, 3 SVG paths, status 'Live pull unavailable · using embedded snapshot'.

commands.name: csv-parser
commands.command: Chrome DevTools Protocol evaluated parseCsv on a date,value sample
commands.result: The parser accepted 18 valid monthly rows.

commands.name: interactive-controls
commands.command: Chrome DevTools Protocol changed horizon, risk regime, chart range, and model
commands.result: Horizon changed to 6 mo, high-risk width to 21.2%, the scenario table changed to 3 rows, and the chart remained populated with 3 paths; the momentum model produced a finite base of 8452.64.

commands.name: source-disclosure
commands.result: FRED responded HTTP/2 200 with application/csv; the final page visibly discloses the embedded snapshot and optional live refresh behavior.

warnings: The live FRED browser refresh was unavailable during the HTTP validation path, so the dashboard used its embedded historical snapshot as explicitly disclosed.
Headless Chrome emitted non-fatal GPU, GCM, and TensorFlow Lite diagnostics in the benchmark stderr log.

commands.name: npm-install
commands.result: Installed and audited 4 packages; 0 vulnerabilities reported.

commands.name: full-test-suite
commands.result: All 4 unit tests and 5 browser tests passed; 1 intentional mobile-project skip.

commands.name: new-row-target-http
commands.command: Serve the repository at http://127.0.0.1:4321/ and request /runs/rendered/openai-gpt-5-6-luna-xhigh-codex-20260812.html
commands.result: The manifest-generated target returned HTTP/1.0 200 OK with Content-Length 41371 and contained the S&P 500 / Forecast Lab title, FRED source label, embedded snapshot status, and main chart. app.js maps each row's manifest displayHtml to the row link and click navigation.

commands.name: in-app-browser-availability
commands.command: Required in-app browser setup, troubleshooting read, and browser availability check
commands.result: The in-app browser backend was unavailable and returned an empty browser list; no interactive click-through claim is made.

importVerification.result: Repository checks pass, and the new row's generated standalone target resolves directly with the expected dashboard markers. Interactive in-app click-through could not be observed because that backend was unavailable in this session.
